jobs.title: AI/ML Software Engineer – Gateway & Edge AI
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Software Engineering General Summary: Qualcomm is looking for a highly motivated AI/ML Software Engineer to develop next-generation AI capabilities for gateway and edge products. This role will focus on applying Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, agentic AI, and traditional machine learning to create intelligent networking experiences and services. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI/ML experience and an interest in deploying AI on resource-constrained edge platforms . The engineer will work across on-device, cloud, and hybrid AI architectures to enable intelligent diagnostics, network optimization, security, automation, and user experiences. Job Responsibilities Design and develop AI/GenAI features and use cases for gateway and edge products , translating real-world networking problems into production-ready AI solutions. Develop AI-powered capabilities for network diagnostics, troubleshooting, optimization, security, automation, anomaly detection, and intelligent user experiences . Integrate and optimize LLMs, SLMs, and ML models for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Develop on-device, cloud, and hybrid AI solutions , selecting the appropriate execution model based on latency, privacy, compute, memory, power, and connectivity requirements. Build agentic AI and tool-calling capabilities that allow AI models to interact with device services, network telemetry, diagnostics, configuration, and other system functions. Develop reusable AI inference, model-serving, and model-management capabilities that make AI functionality easily consumable by gateway applications. Evaluate and optimize models for accuracy, latency, throughput, memory utilization, compute requirements, and power efficiency . Apply AI optimization techniques such as quantization, fine-tuning, RAG, prompt/context optimization, caching, and intelligent model selection/routing . Prototype emerging AI use cases, evaluate technical feasibility and product value, and transition successful concepts toward production. Develop AI observability and diagnostics to measure model behavior, inference performance, resource utilization, and system reliability. Collaborate with AI, networking, embedded software, cloud, application, and product teams to deliver production-quality AI features. Evaluate emerging technologies in GenAI, agentic AI, edge AI, multimodal AI, and AI runtimes and identify opportunities to apply them to future gateway products. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field. Strong programming skills in C/C++ and/or Python. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design. Understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI fundamentals. Experience developing or integrating AI/ML models, LLMs, or AI inference frameworks. Good understanding of Linux systems development and debugging. Understanding of AI performance characteristics such as latency, throughput, memory utilization, model accuracy, and compute requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to debug issues across software, AI models, and system layers. Preferred Qualifications Experience deploying AI models on embedded, edge, IoT, networking, or other resource-constrained devices. Experience with LLMs/SLMs, model inference, quantization, fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, and context management. Experience with agentic AI, function/tool calling, MCP, or similar agent frameworks. Familiarity with AI runtimes and hardware acceleration across CPU, GPU, and NPU. Experience with model ecosystems and tooling such as PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, GGUF, or equivalent frameworks. Understanding of networking, broadband gateways, Wi-Fi, telemetry, diagnostics, or network management. Experience profiling and optimizing AI workloads for latency, memory, compute, and power constraints. Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype through productization and production deployment. Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you? Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team. We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5× growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading. As an SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, NetOS Observability
jobs.description: AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world. We design and implement its network devices and their operating system, NetOS. Every AWS service runs on this network, and every packet in the cloud touches our code! Nobody notices a healthy network. Operators need to know within seconds when a link degrades in one data center, and the first signal comes from software on the device. We write that software. Our team, NetOS Observability, builds the agent that collects metrics, events, and logs from every NetOS device and publishes them to the network telemetry platform. Fleet health systems, SDN controllers, and network operators consume what we ship. We are moving the fleet off a legacy daemon and onto a brand new Rust agent. In 2027, we take it to every supported platform, retire the legacy collectors, and let builders publish a new metric fleet-wide in two weeks. You will own that agent end to end, from its design to its release across the fleet to its behavior in production. The decisions that shape the next decade of network telemetry are open now. We need your help to craft the future. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement the NetOS observability agent in Rust on Linux (ARM64). - Own the telemetry pipeline from device to gateway, including transport, authentication, schema, backpressure, and fleet-scale correctness. - Migrate consumers off the legacy daemon with adapters that preserve their data shape, then retire the daemon. - Build the test and release machinery that ships the component to the fleet on its own cadence. Every release passes its test gate. - Instrument your own systems, define their SLOs, and carry the on-call rotation for them. - Write design documents and review other engineers' designs. Name the dependency early when another team's roadmap gates yours, and negotiate the date. A day in the life You write Rust and test on real routers in our lab. You build for the component teams who define their telemetry in a schema we own, and for the fleet health systems, controllers, and operators who consume it. Every two weeks you settle the device-to-cloud contract with the telemetry platform team. You add a metric to the schema, bring a legacy consumer onto the new pipeline, and run the result on a router under its memory budget. AI agents draft, review, and test alongside you. You ship the component every few weeks and carry its on-call. About the team Our team sits inside NetOS Managed Fleet, which delivers health, observability, and management services for the NetOS fleet. We are growing the team in Raleigh, NC. You work directly with senior engineers and leadership across AWS Networking, and you give technical guidance as the team grows. We own what we ship, and we carry the on-call for the agent in production. We value clear design writing, incremental delivery, and property-based tests. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
